what: What each FL Studio 2026 demo song does and how, read from its project (sandbox copy) and its render, 2026-10-28. tools/demo_study_docs.py merges this with the data in docs/demo_study/data into one page per song. No lyrics are copied.

future_house.summary: A 34-bar future house sketch made with stock plugins only: an 8-bar buildup, a 16-bar drop, an outro. Short, but every element is a lesson in layering.
future_house.form: Buildup 8, Drop 16, Outro 8, Tail 2 (marker names). The buildup already has bass, chords and vocal chops; the drop adds the lead.
future_house.rhythm: Three kicks on one pattern (Grv Kick 18, MA Round Kick 02, Grv Kick 16) make one kick. Three claps on 2 and 4 are nudged apart: Attack Clap 19 sits 0.17 of a 16th early, Attack Clap 12 0.08 early, Fracture Clap 04 on the grid, so the clap is wide and long. Hats: an off-beat open hat plus a closed hat on the last 16th of every beat (...X), shakers syncopated (..o..Xo...o..Xo.).
future_house.bass: GMS sub and GMS mid bass on the same notes, D minor, a short bouncy line.
future_house.harmony: The buildup hangs on A sus4 and Bb (V sus4 against bVI) and only reaches D minor in the drop: tension held until the drop.
future_house.sounds: A MIDI Out channel plays the chords into FL Keys and a scrape sample (MA CoffeePot Scrape) layered as one chord; Wavvyy Synth (Harmless, six-note polyphony) plays the chords as a 16th lead; Wow Synth (3x Osc) for one-shots; white noise breakdowns from 3x Osc.
future_house.vocals: Laurie Webb sample chops (Come On, Baby, Feel It, Ahh) grouped as the drop's hook instrument.
future_house.mix: Basic Sidechain: a Fruity Envelope Controller fired on every beat ducks the music; measured 13.2 dB of pump in the drop (the deepest of the twenty).
future_house.automation: 18 clips: filter and volume moves around the drop.
future_house.transitions: SFX Noise Punch, SFX Mega Sub and Electro Shock hits on the drop instead of a long riser.

bien_duro.summary: A reggaeton production organized like a textbook: its own notebook explains the layout (vocals, radio ad-libs, drums, instruments, bass, SFX, a sidechain ghost), and every section gets a different drum kit on the same dembow.
bien_duro.form: Verse and chorus sections at 95 bpm with an intro; energy is made by swapping kits and adding instrument layers, not by builds.
bien_duro.rhythm: The dembow: kick on 1 and 3 (X.......X.......), the snare's 3-3-2 answer (...X..X...xX..X.), a rim between (o.xx..x.o.xx..x.), timbal runs (x..X.XXxxxXXX.X.) at phrase ends. Kits per section: Oldschool, Darker, Hard, Metal (with Ogun hits), Tibetan, Chase, Pokepop, an epic orchestral tom.
bien_duro.bass: BooBass (FL's modelled bass guitar) playing the dembow bounce: root, held root, octave, root, a gap, root again (F3 . F3 - F4 - F3 - . . F3 . F3 - - -), pumped by Gross Beat.
bien_duro.harmony: F minor: i, bIII, IV with the colours changing by section (sus4 and add9 in the intro, sixths in the verse, plain triads in the chorus).
bien_duro.sounds: Glass pluck (Harmor, release, decay and unison automated), Saw pluck (Harmless), Wasp (Harmor high arp through Blood Overdrive and Flangus), Formanter (Sytrus), Resonator (Sytrus, Mod X and Y automated), a FLEX pad (Olbaid Compendium), ear-candy layers.
bien_duro.vocals: One lead into seven inserts: Main, Duo, Trio, Low, Separated, High, Far, with Pitcher harmonies, a Pitch Shifter formant and delay sends; Radio ad-libs filtered and panned by automation on their own delay.
bien_duro.mix: Sidechain from a silent Sytrus trigger (the notebook: just the pulse behind the pump), so the pump runs on its own grid; send buses for vocal delays, radio delay, instrument delays and reverbs.
bien_duro.automation: 46 clips: pluck envelopes, Sytrus mod X and Y, the sidechain mix, vocal gains and reverbs.
bien_duro.transitions: Reverse SFX and impacts (Cymc, Noiz) at section starts; filler toms from 909 and RD kits.

right_night.summary: Pop dance at 105 bpm: one four-chord minor loop for the whole song, the energy made by parts entering, a synth bass drum and a Juno-style bass.
right_night.form: One long section between markers (the project marks only the end): verses and choruses on the same loop.
right_night.rhythm: FL's BassDrum synth as the kick, four on the floor; a sampled snare on 2 and 4; closed hats in a syncopated figure (.XXX..XX.XXX..XX); a shaker on every off-beat 8th; a perc answering late in the bar (..o...oX..X.ooXX).
right_night.bass: Sytrus Juno Bass: root and the fifth below in a two-bar syncopated figure (C#3 - Ab2 - . . C#3 ...), gently pumped.
right_night.harmony: C# minor: i7, v, iv7, IV sus2. The last chord turns the minor fourth major (Dorian) for a lift that never leaves the minor mood.
right_night.sounds: Sytrus Brass stabs, Brass Synth, Harmor Dark Pad, Dream Pad, Rhodes MK 1, a Harmor bell, muted guitar samples through overdrive and delays.
right_night.vocals: Lead vocal and features, no chop games.
right_night.mix: A Peak Controller on the kick drives the bass and synths; a Love Philter preset named Sidechain does the same job on another bus; measured pump only 1.9 dB: pop pumps gently.
right_night.automation: 77 clips: filters, sends and volumes per section.
right_night.transitions: Guitar and FX swells rather than risers.

im_awake.summary: Big room EDM at 124 bpm: maximal layering (six claps, seven 3x Osc channels on one lead), kick changes per section, builds by ramped snare rolls.
im_awake.form: Intro, verses with the vocal, builds, two drops, an outro: the classic two-drop club form.
im_awake.rhythm: Six clap samples on 2 and 4 as one clap; a kick per section (Halloween, StadiumHop); an off-beat hat plus a 16th ticker on every second 16th (.X.X.X.X); snare rolls in 16ths with velocity ramping from 64 to 128; metal hits as percussion; Fruity Slicer breaks.
im_awake.bass: Growl bass samples played on syncopated hits (Bass Growel Notes) over 3x Osc bass layers.
im_awake.harmony: D minor with both a Dorian IV (G, G7) and a Phrygian bII (Eb sus2): bright and dark in four bars.
im_awake.sounds: 3x Osc stacks (seven channels on one Layer for the lead, five on another for the bass), bounced audio layers playing the same MIDI, Toxic Biohazard high arp, DL breaker and broken leads.
im_awake.vocals: Vocal cut chops pitched as a hook, plus the lead.
im_awake.mix: Pump measured 2.1 dB: the loudness (-6.5 LUFS) comes from density, not from ducking.
im_awake.automation: 93 clips, the most of the set: filters, volumes and FX on almost every layer.
im_awake.transitions: Snare rolls, risers and impacts into every drop.

time.summary: Liquid drum and bass at 170 bpm built around a vocal arranged like a choir: lead, doubles, harmonies, textures and ad-libs on their own buses.
time.form: A long intro (bars of sparse pads and plucks), drops with the two-step, breakdowns with the vocal stack.
time.rhythm: Kick on 1 and the 'and' of 3 (X.........X.....), snare on 2 and 4, a tambourine and an 18-inch crash on every quarter; a shuffled break loop for tops.
time.bass: 3x Osc sine sub held under the chords; the bass bus is automated.
time.harmony: Eb minor: an intro of bVII sus2, iv add9, bIII sus4, then i7 and bVI maj7, and a Dorian IV sus2 in the chorus.
time.sounds: FLEX plucks (Olbaid Compendium: Driving Through, Driven Distruct, Progressive Impact) octave-doubled on descending arps; GMS; pads as audio.
time.vocals: Lead, doubles left and right, an ambient double, a robot double through Blood Overdrive, high, mid and low harmonies, hums, 'oh's, ad-libs; buses Lead, Doubles, Harmonies, Vocal Texture, Adlib; one LuxeVerb send.
time.mix: Pump 1.6 dB (barely any); LRA 9.8 LU, the second most dynamic: the drops are 12 LU over the intro.
time.automation: Bass bus and pluck volume moves.

africas_calling.summary: Afro house at 120 bpm with no drop at all: the record moves by filters opening over 16 bars, percussion layers entering and a chord pluck's decay growing.
africas_calling.form: 16-bar phrases; the peak is the moment every filter is open.
africas_calling.rhythm: A three-step kick (X.......X...X...), shakers on almost every 16th with accents (XX.XXX.XXX.XXX.X), wood drops and percussion sitting a third of a 16th late (a 66 % swing, a triplet feel against the straight kick), a clap pushed 0.4 of a 16th early before each beat, a FLEX GM cowbell on quarters and an agogo.
africas_calling.bass: The bass barely plays: two quick notes on the flat second (F over E) at the end of the bar resolve to the root on the next downbeat; a GMS layer holds longer notes.
africas_calling.harmony: E minor: i, bVII6, bVI maj7 and i, v7, bVI maj7.
africas_calling.sounds: FLEX Arp (Mobile Synth Pluck, Synpluck Dual) on a tresillo-grouped arp (E4 B4 - G4 E4+E5 B4 - G4) whose cutoff opens over 16 bars; Harmless chord pluck with its decay automated and a Fruity Filter sweep; Morphine and GMS synths; strings; Sakura.
africas_calling.vocals: The vocal with reverb and delay throws placed by short automation clips.
africas_calling.mix: Buses All Drums, Sfx, Chromatics, Bass, Synths, Pads, All Music, Mix Buss and one global reverb send; pump 2.6 dB.
africas_calling.automation: 21 clips: the arp's cutoff over 16 bars, the pluck's decay, GMS amp release, throws.

night_terror.summary: Electro industrial at 108 bpm: one 16th bass ostinato on four layers carries everything; the form is named like a song (V1, Drop 1, V2, Mid 8, Mid 8 Ramp, Drop 2, Re-Intro).
night_terror.form: Intro, V1, Drop 1, V2, Mid 8, Mid 8 Ramp, Drop 2, Re-Intro, EndZII: a middle section and a ramp instead of a second build, and an ending that quotes the start.
night_terror.rhythm: A minimal kick on every beat, closed hats on every 16th, four claps stacked as one with a ghost an 8th before the backbeat (..o.X.......X...), an open hat only on the bar's first beat, a second kick stuttering at the end of every fourth bar.
night_terror.bass: DEDZII TERROR (Sytrus through Gross Beat and distortion), Square Sub (Sytrus), 808 Flattened (FLEX) and Dedziiboost (Harmor an octave up) all play the same 16th ostinato.
night_terror.harmony: E, mostly the root and its fifth: the harmony is the bass's register and grit.
night_terror.sounds: Crushspeak Now (FLEX), a croaking, talking lead with its high-pass and timbre automated; EQ band sweeps.
night_terror.vocals: None: the croak lead does the vocal's job.
night_terror.mix: Pump 7.7 dB from Gross Beat on the bass; width -13.1 dB (one of the narrowest): a mono, frontal mix.
night_terror.automation: 16 clips: the croak's filter and timbre, EQ sweeps.
night_terror.transitions: The Mid 8 Ramp climbs into Drop 2.

song_for_you.summary: Liquid drum and bass at 174 bpm in C# major, made of breaks: sliced breakbeats played in order, then re-ordered ('Ghost Break'), under layered pads.
song_for_you.form: Intro, drops, breakdown, the second drop with re-ordered breaks.
song_for_you.rhythm: Slicex breaks and Fruity Slicer tops carry the groove; programmed kicks (X.........X.....) reinforce them.
song_for_you.bass: GMS reese and a 3x Osc sub held (F2 for 12 steps, then F#2).
song_for_you.harmony: One chord, four colours: C#6, C# sus2, C# maj7, C# sus4 repeating. The harmony moves without the root moving.
song_for_you.sounds: Pads layered from Kepler, DX10, FL Keys made crusty and run through a vocoder, FLEX Alumin Sun and FLEX Scatter Clouds strings; Sytrus octave arp in quarters; FLEX Synpluck Square; Ogun bells.
song_for_you.vocals: Vocal chops doubled, an ambient loop.
song_for_you.mix: LRA 12.2 LU, the most dynamic of the set: long quiet passages and full drops.
song_for_you.transitions: Impacts and risers made from the song's material.

inner_days.summary: Lo-fi at 75 bpm: a jazzy minor loop of sevenths on piano and guitar, a swung boom bap, a held bass, instruments entering and leaving.
inner_days.form: No builds or drops: parts enter and leave every 4 to 8 bars.
inner_days.rhythm: HIP kit: kick on 1, the 'a' of 2 and 3 (X......X..X....x), snare on 2 with late ghosts (....X......ox.x.), a swung hat with small doubles (..X..xX...X..xxX), a shaker on every 16th.
inner_days.bass: Sytrus bass held a bar per chord.
inner_days.harmony: D minor: i7, bIII maj7, bVI maj7, IV7 (the Dorian IV as a dominant seventh), every chord a seventh or ninth.
inner_days.sounds: DirectWave piano (wide voicings D3+C4+D4 under F4+A4) and guitar (a melodic 16th riff), strings.
inner_days.mix: Simple: the sound is the samples and the swing.

inner_days_rework.summary: The same song reworked (SH-1 Rework feat. Maja Mannila): a model of what a rework changes and keeps, the closest thing in the set to what the co-producer does.
inner_days_rework.form: The original's loop and parts, with a sung vocal added and the energy reshaped around it.
inner_days_rework.rhythm: The same drums as the original.
inner_days_rework.bass: The held bass re-cut as a syncopated line (x---x--x--x-x---) and doubled two octaves down by a Heavy 808 (Sytrus): the same harmony with a hip-hop pocket.
inner_days_rework.sounds: A Harmor octave pluck (D4+D5 in a syncopated 16th figure) replaces a melodic line; piano, guitar and strings kept.
inner_days_rework.vocals: Lead and harmonies with mid and side EQ and LuxeVerbs; a VOX bus.
inner_days_rework.mix: New buses: SC (kick and snare into a bus that keys Limiter sidechain gates on the music), KS, Music, VOX; the master gets a WaveShaper and a limiter; reverb and delay wet, a band-pass and a master filter are automated.
inner_days_rework.automation: Reverb and delay wet, band-pass, master filter.
rework_lessons: keep the harmony, the drums and the signature instruments
change the bass's rhythm and add a register (an 808 two octaves down)
replace one melodic part with a new instrument (an octave pluck) instead of adding on top
add a sidechain bus that keys the music from kick and snare
put the space under control: reverb and delay wet automated per section

exoplanet.summary: Trance at 140 bpm, built in additive 8-bar blocks named 1er Cambio to 6to Cambio (changes), with a long pre-drop and breakdown: the clearest lesson in pacing.
exoplanet.form: Intro blocks of 8 to 16 bars, each adding a part or opening a filter; PRE DROP 32; BREAKDOWN; drop.
exoplanet.rhythm: Four on the floor plus a GHOST kick channel (the sidechain trigger); closed hats on the three 16ths after each kick (.XXX), an open hat and a ride on the off-beat, two percussion voices on the 'a' of beats (...X..X....X..X.), claps on 2 and 4 from two channels; snare rolls in 16ths from velocity 31 to 100 over the build.
exoplanet.bass: The rolling bass: per beat a rest where the kick hits, then root, root, octave, the second beat swapping the octave for the minor seventh (. A1 A1 A2 . A1 G2 A1); Harmor, 3x Osc, Harmless and Sytrus layers into a bass bus with EQ, WaveShaper, Maximus, limiters and two filters; a very short 3x Osc sub (0.08 beats).
exoplanet.harmony: A minor: F, G, Dm, E (VI, VII, iv, major V); the breakdown turns to C (Am G C Cmaj7 Am7 Fadd9).
exoplanet.sounds: Main Lead stack: four MiniSynths, two Sytrus, two Harmor and a vocal sample on the same gated chord line with the bass octave between the hits; Pluck - Saku (Sakura) falling C5 B4 G4 E4; Harmless pedal arp (A3 between rising tones); Energic Pads (MiniSynth), Pads 2 (Sytrus); FL Keys piano layers; a Sytrus cello and Sakura lead in the breakdown.
exoplanet.vocals: A vocal sample doubled into the lead stack.
exoplanet.mix: Pump only 0.9 dB measured: the GHOST trigger works on the bass and pads, not the whole mix; -6.0 LUFS, the loudest with With You.
exoplanet.automation: 85 clips: kick low-pass in the breakdown, bass bus filters and WaveShaper mix, pad and arp filters opening over 32 to 260 beats, MiniSynth filter velocity, master reverb wet and master filter, a 12-point tempo clip.
exoplanet.transitions: The low-pass opening is the build; the master reverb is the breakdown.

mic_check.summary: UK drill at 143 bpm in loop blocks: one dark loop, drums dropping out every third block, a vocal production chain with driven ad-libs and tempo delays.
mic_check.form: 16 blocks of 8 bars; intro and outro are pads and vocal only; every third block has no drums.
mic_check.rhythm: The snare on beat 3 with a late answer (........x...o.o.), a kick that changes every bar, 'counter snare' hats in uneven 16th groups (Bb3 . . Bb3 . Bb3 Bb3 . . . . . Bb3 Bb3 Bb3 .), a perc on the 'a' of 1 and 2.
mic_check.bass: A throaty 808 held for most of the bar; a drill reese sample under it.
mic_check.harmony: C minor: i add9 against bVI, with a flat-II sus2 turn (Phrygian).
mic_check.sounds: FLEX Arksun Cityscape pad (Phasic Anomoly), a Harmless pad, FLEX Strung Space strings (Olbaid Compendium), a high Sytrus pad through Gross Beat, a Sytrus choir, FL Keys high notes with delay.
mic_check.vocals: Lead Vocal Bus, Lead Vocal Adlib Bus (Blood Overdrive), Hook Vocal Bus, Hook Stab Bus, sends REVERB, 1/4 DELAY, 1/2 DELAY; pan offset thrown on single words.
mic_check.mix: A Beat Bus with a soft clipper over Melody and Drum buses, the 808 through Spreader and a limiter; pump 4.6 dB is the 808 and kick, not a sidechain.
mic_check.automation: The master balance, the Bell delay mix, two short pan throws.
mic_check.transitions: Gunshot impact, risers, a drum-fill sample at block edges.

shine.summary: Afrobeats written at 178 bpm, felt at 89: a two-bar loop, a log drum talking over an 8th-note pulse bass, FLEX orchestral colours.
shine.form: One loop under the whole song, the vocal carrying the sections.
shine.rhythm: Kick x...x.........x., hats on 8ths and syncopated, a 22-inch ride on quarters, tambourine and wood hits.
shine.bass: Log drum (Fruity DX10) answering late in the beat (......x---..x---) over Synpluck Cube (FLEX) and Morphine pulses in 8ths.
shine.harmony: F minor: i7, i add9, bIII maj7 held for two bars.
shine.sounds: FLEX Harp, Enlightenment, Synpluck Cube, Brass Sections and Flute from the General Midi Library; Morphine basses; FL Piano.
shine.vocals: The lead with its delay mix automated.
shine.mix: -15.1 LUFS with 18.2 dB crest: mixed for streaming, not the club.
shine.transitions: None to speak of: the loop never stops.

madonna.summary: Trip hop and lounge at 91 bpm: a lazy kick, hand drums in layers, a Neapolitan chord loop, dub sends on the vocal.
madonna.form: Intro, verse, chorus, a second verse and chorus, an outro.
madonna.rhythm: Kick in pairs (X..X....X..X....), the backbeat late and soft, bongos on every 16th with velocity rising and falling (3 to 100), two congas and two 'indie' percs interlocking, a low war drum at the bar's end, a jazz ride.
madonna.bass: Sytrus bass and a chorused Midbass on a dotted 3-3-2 figure (Ab2 - - Ab2 - - - - Ab2 - - Ab2 - - Ab1 -), the last note dropping an octave.
madonna.harmony: G minor: iv7, i7, bII maj7, bIII6, with a G7 turnaround once in four.
madonna.sounds: Ogun high chords (sevenths, chorused, in reverb), Morphine soft pad, a bright pad through a Love Philter, Harmor blips on a falling chromatic line, a tuned percussion line falling chromatically, risers and drops from samples.
madonna.vocals: Dry and close; a delay bank into a reverb and a reverb send, both ridden by automation; breaths dipped by 97-point volume clips.
madonna.mix: An SC bus (Limiter presets Transients and Hard Noise Gate) keyed into pads, bass and chords; a Drum Verb bus with Pitch Shifter and Blood Overdrive before the reverb; a Tonal Bus through a Frequency Shifter.
madonna.automation: Frequency Shifter mix, frequency and feedback, HPF, vocal sends, breath dips.
madonna.transitions: Sample drops (8-bit, reverse, static shock) at section starts.

never_out.summary: Drum and bass at 165 bpm with Persian colour: setar ad-libs, a tombak, FLEX Cityscape leads, sliced drum loops re-sequenced.
never_out.form: An 8-bar drone intro, a long first section, drops at bar 33 and bar 73.
never_out.rhythm: Kick X.X.......X....., snare on 2 and 4, open hats on the off-beats, Fruity Slicer drum loops played chromatically as new patterns.
never_out.bass: Harmor (Bajo Melbourne, Basic wobbling, Bajo Bounce) and GMS (Disco Fuzz) into one Decimate voice bus; FLEX Submarine on an octave bounce (C#3 . C#3 . C#4 .).
never_out.harmony: F minor: an F sus4 to F m add9 drone, then iv, bVI, i5, V sus4.
never_out.sounds: FLEX Arksun Cityscape (Phoenix, Enlightenment, Dystopian Lead, Cruncher), Harmless duck stabs (minor triads), DirectWave piano for the outro.
never_out.vocals: Vocal main with delay, reverb, phaser and Soundgoodizer; setar ad-libs with their formant automated.
never_out.mix: Reverb and delay sends shared by many parts; the master only EQ, multiband and Wave Candy.
never_out.automation: FLEX master filter on Phoenix and Cruncher, Love Philter on the drum loop, the setar's formant.
never_out.transitions: Reverse piano chords, a wind riser, a sub impact, a reversed tombak.

with_you.summary: Melodic techno at 126 bpm made almost entirely from FLEX's Melodic Techno pack and Fruity DrumSynth Live, with a vocal that ducks the leads.
with_you.form: Start 8, Vocal P1 28, Vocal Break Down 16, Build up 8, Drop 32, Outro 12.
with_you.rhythm: Every drum from DrumSynth Live: kick four on the floor, closed hat on every 16th, open hat and a percussion tone on the off-beat, a ride on 8ths, a reverb clap hit at section starts.
with_you.bass: BAS Lottunma (FLEX) and a Harmor sub on every 16th of D, the release and cutoff automated over 128 beats; a Patcher does multiband sidechain.
with_you.harmony: D minor: sixteen bars of a bare fifth, then minor seventh and major sixth on the same root, then bVI maj7, bVII6, i, v.
with_you.sounds: FLEX presets PLK Navid (the 16th sequence A4 F4 D5 D5 D4 D4 C5 D5 ...), PLK Diaco, PLK Shirin, PLK Sadaf, LED Hannaneh, LED Arnika, LED Kian, KEY Eligash, PAD Minoo, SFX Crasha; a five-note Sytrus pad; 3x Osc noise and saw sweeps.
with_you.vocals: Pitch Shifter, Pitcher, Maximus and a Peak Controller on the vocal; Stereo Vocal and Vocal Widness buses; a vocal reverb gated by Gross Beat and ducked under the next line; a shimmer reverb.
with_you.mix: Master: Patcher mid and side EQ, a make-up EQ, WaveShaper hard clip, Emphasis limiter; -6.0 LUFS at 7.9 dB crest, the densest master of the set.
with_you.automation: 71 clips, most of them FLEX macros (Space, Metal, Plucked, OSCEX, TuneX, FlungDL, LPF, arpeggio gate and time), a low-frequency EQ band, delay input wet.
with_you.transitions: Noise and saw sweeps from 3x Osc, filter automation, SFX Crasha.

thief.summary: Future bass at 150 bpm: half-time drops, an 808 snare roll rising in pitch, saw chords and bass gated by Gross Beat, a music-box bell arp doubled in octaves.
thief.form: Verse, build, half-time drop, verse, build, drop, with a tempo automation clip.
thief.rhythm: Snare (two snareclaps and a conga) on beat 3 only; a skipping kick (X...o...x...x.o.); a ride on 1 and 3; the 808 snare rolling 16ths in builds with its pitch automated.
thief.bass: Harmless synth bass held; a 3x Osc saw bass through Gross Beat in the drop (B2 for 9 steps, Ab2 for 4); white noise from 3x Osc playing the bass's rhythm.
thief.harmony: C# major: bVII, V, I, II as power chords (the major II is a Lydian lift).
thief.sounds: Tinke Bell (FLEX General Midi Library) doubled two octaves (Bb4+Bb6) on a fast arp; Piano Dark (FLEX); sax samples.
thief.vocals: A vocal with a Vocodex send; Free Filter sweeps on the vocal bus.
thief.mix: Pump 12.1 dB, the second deepest: Gross Beat and a Balance 'Volume Duck' clip; the kick feeds buses as a sidechain source.
thief.automation: The 808 snare's pitch, Gross Beat, Free Filter, crash reverb, tempo.
thief.transitions: The pitched snare roll is the build.

use_me.summary: Afrobeats at 100 bpm, minimal: two kicks (a four on the floor and a tresillo), two percussion hits, a sus-cell arp through overdrive, the vocal.
use_me.form: Intro, verse, hook, verse, hook, a 'try me' section, bridge, outro (marker names).
use_me.rhythm: Priime kick four on the floor, gbe kick on the 3-3-2 tresillo (X..X..X.X..X..X.), percussion on the last 16th of beats 1 and 3, a tight snare.
use_me.bass: A one-shot bass sample, a 16th Sytrus synth bass through Effector, a Peak Controller on the sub.
use_me.harmony: C# minor, mostly the sus-cell arp's notes (1, 2, 4, 5): the third is never stated.
use_me.sounds: Synth Arp (Sytrus through Blood Overdrive, Reeverb 2, Love Philter, Effector): C#5 Eb5 F#5 Ab5 C#5 Eb5 Eb5 C#5, its reverb dry and wet automated.
use_me.vocals: Acapella and vox channels, no chops.
use_me.mix: Master only Emphasis; a percussion bus.
use_me.automation: The arp's plate reverb mix and Reeverb 2 dry and wet, the percussion bus mix.

stroll_up.summary: Trap at 147 bpm in E minor over a pedal: grouped hats, a half-time clap, a clean FLEX 808 that steps to the flat second, a staccato bell ostinato.
stroll_up.rhythm: Ekit 4 Hat in grouped 16ths (xXX.xXX..xx.xxx.), Grv Snareclap on beat 3 with two ghosts (........X....oo.), vintage-kit fills (VT_SD, VT_MC, VT_CL, rimshots) in fill bars.
stroll_up.bass: FLEX 808 Clean (Mobile Tuned 808 Bass) held, re-struck late, stepping E3 to F3; an 808 Clav sample; BooBass in a high register as a funky counter line.
stroll_up.harmony: E pedal with F maj7 (the Phrygian bII), D add9 and C.
stroll_up.sounds: FL Keys repeating E6 in short 16ths, FLEX Just Strollin arp (Arksun Cityscape) with its cutoff wobbling over 32 beats, FLEX Creeper Drone through WaveShaper, Hyper Chorus, Love Philter and Spreader, Kepler, FLEX Driving Through as a lead.
stroll_up.vocals: Choir Ahh (DirectWave), a vocal with delay and Hyper Chorus.
stroll_up.mix: Master: two EQs, a Patcher, Blood Overdrive, an EQ, Stereo Enhancer: the master is part of the sound. LRA 1.5 LU: flat on purpose.
stroll_up.automation: The arp's cutoff (21 points over 32 beats), Hyper Chorus, vocal mix, Love Philter.

secret_agent.summary: A spy-film cue at 120 bpm that slows to 110: odd meters (7/4, 6/4, 3/4), a minor chord with a major seventh, a chromatic guitar, a harp glissando, one hall reverb.
secret_agent.form: Markers 120 Bpm, 4/4, C Min, 110 Bpm, 7/4, 6/4, 4/4, 3/4, 4/4: the form follows the scenes.
secret_agent.rhythm: A swung ride (X.xoX.xoX.xoX.xx), a hat pedal on quarters, toms, FPC wacks and a big HIT at phrase ends.
secret_agent.bass: Harmor 'Forest' repeating one note in 16ths, Strat Mute guitar (DirectWave), Kepler AceBass.
secret_agent.harmony: C minor: C m(maj7), Ab maj7, Bb7, Ab add9.
secret_agent.sounds: DirectWave Rhodes (C4, C5+G4, Eb5+G5+B5), Stage Grand piano stabs, Piezo guitar on D, Eb, E, FLEX harp glissando, Wave Traveller leads, DJ scratches, earthquake SFX, a moving choir.
secret_agent.mix: One LuxeVerb Bright Hall (3 s) fed by every instrument; a Peak Controller kick sidechain; -16.4 LUFS at 19.5 dB crest: a film mix.
secret_agent.automation: Tempo, the scratch pitch mix, the 3x Osc cutoff and resonance, Rhodes and guitar levels, a PanOMatic switch.
